title: Add CI freeze guard for audited D&D SRD 5.1 artifact
description: The D&D SRD 5.1 rules-pack under packages/core/data/rules-packs/ is a completed, audited artifact generated by the one-time importer. It must never silently change in CI. We need a freeze guard — a CI check (checksum, snapshot, or content-hash test) that fails the build if the committed SRD artifact is modified without a deliberate, reviewed update. This prevents accidental parser or schema changes from silently corrupting the only licensed rules content we ship.
acceptance_criteria: A CI step or Vitest test computes a stable identity (file hash or structured snapshot) over the SRD rules-pack output. The check fails if the artifact diverges from the committed baseline. The baseline is updated only intentionally (e.g. a deliberate re-import with reviewer sign-off). The guard is documented so contributors know why the check exists and how to update it legitimately.
close_reason: Implemented: freeze-manifest.json, verify:dnd5e-srd-freeze script, srd-freeze-guard.yml CI workflow, thaw-notes/TEMPLATE.md, 16 unit tests. Branch eshyra-ixcd-srd-freeze-guard ready for PR.
